name: jairf-animation
description: JAIRF animation roadmap (per 02_Animation_List.md). Standard humanoid avatar. Locomotion (idle/walk/run/sprint/jump/fall/climb/swim/crouch), generic combat (draw/sheathe/combo/heavy/block/hit forms/death/revive/dodge), class-specific (Warrior heavy/shield bash/charge; Mage cast/channel; Archer bow draw/hold/release), social & emotes, builder mode gestures, interaction (loot/door/talk/craft), enemy base set, NPC set. Tech: upper-body layers, optional root motion.
